VIBE EDITING · SETUP GUIDE

HOW TO SET IT UP

THREE STEPS
1

GET THE CLAUDE CODE APP
Download it from claude.com/claude-code, open it, and sign in. This one app does
everything — there's nothing else to install. (You'll need a paid Claude plan: Pro or Max.)

2

PASTE THE SETUP BOX
Start a new chat in Claude Code and paste the box on the next page. The GitHub link is
already inside it — Claude downloads everything and sets up your machine for you.
Repo: github.com/maddexritter-rgb/vibe-editing

3

ANSWER ITS QUESTIONS
Claude will ask about your brand — logo, fonts, colors, music, and how you like your clips.
Answer in plain English and drag in files when it asks. Then it makes you a test clip.
Tip

If it asks permission to install something, just click Allow. It keeps a checklist at the

top so you can watch it work.

→ THE BOX TO PASTE IS ON THE NEXT PAGE

embedded_text:
VIBE EDITING · SETUP GUIDE

STEP 2 · THE SETUP BOX

PASTE THIS INTO
CLAUDE CODE
Copy the entire box below and paste it into a new Claude Code chat. The GitHub
link is already inside it — you don't need to type anything else.
✂ COPY THIS WHOLE BOX INTO CLAUDE CODE

PASTE & GO

You're setting up "Vibe Editing" for me on this Mac. I am NOT technical, so do everything
yourself, never make me run a terminal command or edit a file by hand, and explain each step
in plain English. Keep a visible to-do list and check items off as you go.
1) GET THE KIT
git clone https://github.com/maddexritter-rgb/vibe-editing.git

(into my Documents folder)

Then do all the work inside that "vibe-editing" folder. Install git/Homebrew first if
needed.
2) SET UP MY MACHINE (install only what's missing, all free)
Run: python3 plugins/vibe-editing/doctor.py

-> install only the missing pieces yourself

(ffmpeg, yt-dlp, tesseract, rclone, a Python .venv + faster-whisper). Re-run until READY.
3) FAST TRANSCRIPTION (free)
Walk me through getting a free Groq key at console.groq.com, then save it for me.
If I skip it, set the kit to use the free offline transcription instead.
4) MAKE IT MY BRAND (interview me, ONE question at a time)
Brand name? Logo? Caption font + look (I'll paste a screenshot)? Music? My topics +
how a clip should OPEN and END? Any editing preferences? Apply it all and show me.
5) MAKE A TEST CLIP
Ask me for one video, run it, show me the finished clip, adjust until I love it.
Be patient, assume I've never used a terminal, and only use this kit.
